So I've been holding onto this info since January this year and have been too afraid to come forward with it as I am such a small streamer and this could possibly be carrier suicide going up against someone of her size, and as I type this my heart is racing and my body is warm with fear of the backlash I will get from her fans and possibly friends, but I CANNOT live in fear and need to come forward with this info.

@ElaraVtuber IS NOT a good person.

I have screenshots of a conversation with her back in January on Discord, as well as with her mod asking if I should confront her with it, AS WELL AS a screenshot from october of 2024 that backs up my claims of her being a horrible person.

To start from the beginning, back in October 2024 there was the whole massive Pokemon Leak where tons of files were leaked online. One in particular was a fanfic by one of the Devs about a Typlosion Raping a human. The whole idea of this story existing by one of the devs of a series I grew up with when I myself was a victim of Rape MULTIPLE TIMES in my life was very triggering for me.

Elara decided to cover the leaks on stream and at the time I was a regular in her chat and when she said she was going to read that particular story my flight or flight response went into overdrive so I sent 100 bits for TTS to beg her not to read it as I was a victim of SA and I offered to gift 5 subs if she didn't read it. She ended up laughing at me saying "don't tell me what to do" which made me have a panic attack and go into her partner Aia's discord begging Aia to step in. I will also note before closing the stream I saw people in chat typing "CANCELED" and "WTF ELARA?"

I ended up getting lectured by Aia and some of their shared mods (which I don't have screenshots as I was banned from the discord a few months back). Later on I got a DM from Elara saying she was sorry I went through that but I shouldn't tell her what to do. Essentually sorry not sorry.

This part is important cuz she ackowledged I told her I was an SA Victim.

Now flash forward to January 19th of this year. Elara was having a guest on stream and I made a comment in chat (which I forgot what it was) and elara sees it and says "why don't you go play your claw games Pachi?" to which I reply "oh good Idea, I do have a free play saved up." to which she makes the comment "yeah go play your claw games and win an anime figure cuz that's the only women you'll ever be touched by".

This made me PISSED because she acknowledged in the previous DM that I was an SA victim. I IMMEDIATELY DMed her Mod Tombsie to ask if I could private message her about what she did. I should note weeks before in December Elara had a Nuaghty or Nice stream and when she read mine I had said my naughty was "believing a lie told to me about Elara". Elara used this to go on a 20 minute rant directed at me saying how I shouldn't believe everything but to also "hold my oshis accountable". Keep that part in quotations in mind for the next bit.

When I explained to Tombsie that I wanted to directly tell her instead of a ticket (because I wanted to keep as few eyes off it so it doesn't raise drama....too late for that now) he agreed to DM her. I sent her a DM explained I was very uncomfortable with her mocking me for being single since I CHOOSE to be after my ex had raped me (and she wasn't the first mind you) and offered her other suggestions to make fun of me instead as my relationship status is a touchy subject. I was basically setting a boundry.

Elara again said she was sorry I went through that HOWEVER she claimed she had zero knowledge of me being an SA. This was a flat out lie as shown in her DM from 2024. She then told me I should remove myself from the community because I wanted to set a boundry with her jokes and called me attention seeking. I told her I was simply informing her. she claimed I was trauma dumping. She then told me never to DM her again.

So TLDR 2 years ago I begged Elara not to read a rape story as it triggered me as a rape victim myself, she laughed at me, she then gave a non appology, then 2 years later she tells me "hold your oshis accountable" and when I try to because she made a joke and I wanted to set a boundry, she accused me of attention seeking, claims she wasn't aware, and told me to leave her community.

I know that there will be people who will side with her, I know I may get blocked and banned by bigger vtubers...even ones I look up to, I KNOW there will people who will attack me for holding her accountable, and I KNOW Elara will mnake some bullshit excuse saying I'm attention seeking and she will dodge taking accountability, but I can't live with fear and regret and I need to tell my story as Elara has attacked too many smaller vtubers who don't have as big of voice as her and she needs to be held accountable.

Also due to twitter limits, the other 4 pics will be in a comment below

I don’t want to go back to stupid politics posts. I don’t wanna go back to dumb debates and stupid Game News. I don’t want YouTuber Drama and streamer clips.

I don’t wanna go back

I really need a new twitter feed. 🙄

I’m sick of politics, I’m sick of streamer drama, I’m sick of seeing the same big creators getting banned for being shit humans (happy they are getting what they deserve just sick of it being the only thing I see being talked about). 

I just want to go back to seeing gaming clips, and streamers excited about collabs, partnerships and other accomplishments. I want to see setups and selfies that make someone feel confident and proud. 

😔

New CCTV footage showing the attack on SNEAKO in NYC is featured in his latest YouTube documentary, “READY TO DIE” which documents his Southeast Asia tour following months of controversy and streamer drama. https://t.co/QPzTeAVSCs

Northernlion actually holds a special place for me as his Isaac videos got me through a tough time in my life.

Politics aside, NL definitely knew who Dan was as a person. Throwing your friend of 14 years under the bus over streamer drama is disgusting. He really lost my respect.
